translations.Bệnh nhân là nữ 36 tuổi, người dân tộc H: Patient is a 36-year-old female of Hoa ethnicity, farming in Binh Duong. She has experienced dull epigastric abdominal pain for about 1 month, which worsens after meals, especially fatty or spicy foods. She self-medicated with over-the-counter stomach pain medication but only got temporary relief. Recently, the pain is accompanied by bloating, continuous fullness, and frequent belching. The patient said, 'I think it's because I'm tired from working in the field and caught wind, making my stomach weak,' so she took additional herbal remedies (plant leaves) but they did not help. Symptoms significantly affect eating and sleeping. The patient has a family history of her father having gastric cancer (K25), and she herself was previously found to have gastric ulcer (K21) on examination but did not adhere to complete treatment.
translations.Bệnh nhân là đàn ông Nùng 51 tuổi, cho b: Patient is a 51-year-old male of Nung ethnicity, reporting that lower back and leg pain has persisted for over 2 years. Initially, it was only sore lumbar pain, thought to be due to heavy farm work, so he self-medicated with forest herbs (traditional medicine) and felt relief. Over the past 6 months, the pain has gradually increased, radiating to the buttocks and posterior right thigh, making movement very difficult. Recently, sharp severe pain occurs with each step, accompanied by numbness from the heel up to the knee. In addition, the patient has a lot of white phlegm cough, especially in the morning, feels fatigued, weight loss is noticeable, and experiences loss of appetite. Seeing a family member with lung cancer (C34) caused great concern, and combined with difficulty in transportation, he decided to go to the medical center.
translations.Bệnh nhân nam 51 tuổi, dân tộc Nùng, sin: 51-year-old male patient of Nung ethnicity, residing in the highland area of Cao Bang, presents for examination with dull low back pain radiating to the buttocks and posterior right thigh, accompanied by numbness extending down to the heel. Due to language and geographical barriers, the patient often self-treats with traditional medicine before seeking care at the medical center, leading to chronic neurological symptoms. Currently, sharp pain occurs when walking, causing severe limitation of mobility and greatly affecting daily activities.

She complains of dull epigastric pain, bloating, frequent belching, and a burning sensation after meals; symptoms worsen when lying down, causing difficulty sleeping. She is currently taking Esomeprazole 40mg and Domperidone 10mg, but symptoms are not fully controlled.
translations.Bệnh nhân nữ 53 tuổi, dân tộc Kinh, ngụ: 53-year-old female patient of Kinh ethnicity, residing in Quang Nam, with a history of ulcerative colitis (K51) not well controlled. Main symptoms are dull left lower quadrant abdominal pain that comes in cramps, frequent passage of loose stools with mucus, accompanied by low-grade fever in the afternoon and fatigue. This is a clear flare-up of chronic intestinal inflammation, requiring examination and endoscopy to assess inflammation severity and rule out complications locally.
